title: Revisit v2.0 Hint with Updated CODATA/PDG Values
verdict: HINT_PERSISTS — best rational unchanged, error marginally larger (6.12e-7 vs 5.76e-7) due to more precise m_e value (CODATA 2022 vs previously used 0.511 MeV). Factor vs Dirichlet slightly degraded (1.63× vs 1.7×). Still below the ≥10× threshold for claiming evidence.
